note: Adapted from the species-level description no. 159 in Chhotani (1997), The Fauna of India, Isoptera; original in English; the alate description is based on a single paratype colony specimen and the original notes a marked difference from the original description; all three castes present, nymph absent. Synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers, distribution records and wing-surface micro-ornamentation omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, sides slightly convex; mandibles long and slender, finely serrate, apex not strongly hooked; postmentum rod-like with the waist near the posterior margin. Alate head capsule subquadrate, widest anteriorly; Y-suture and fontanelle indistinct; compound eyes separated from the lower margin of the head by less than their minimum diameter; posterior part of the postclypeus projecting toward the frons.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head and pronotum yellow, moderately pilose. Body length 5.0–5.3 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, sides slightly convex (1.26 mm to mandible bases, width 0.87–1.00 mm). Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Labrum subquadrate, anterior margin rounded. Mandibles long and slender, finely serrate (length 0.93–1.12 mm), slightly shorter than the head (left mandible length to head length ratio about 0.79–0.80). Postmentum rod-like (length 0.57–0.71 mm, maximum width 0.31–0.34 mm, waist width 0.23–0.26 mm), waist near the posterior margin. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.28–0.34 mm, width 0.57–0.68 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head pale yellowish brown; antennae, legs and body cream yellow; postclypeus slightly lighter than the head capsule. Head and body moderately pilose. Body length about 3.30 mm. Head subquadrate (0.73 mm to mandible bases, maximum width 0.73 mm). Antennae 13-segmented; segment 2 equal to the sum of segments 3 and 4, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus slightly convex, more than half as long as wide (length 0.25 mm, width 0.40 mm). Pronotum weakly saddle-shaped (length 0.25 mm, width 0.48 mm); anterior margin slightly concave, posterior margin nearly straight.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown with red; antennae brown; postclypeus reddish brown, lighter than the head capsule; pronotum dark brown; abdominal tergites reddish brown like the postclypeus; sternites mainly brown, lighter in the middle. Head and body rather densely pilose. Head capsule subquadrate, widest anteriorly (0.88 mm to mandible bases, maximum width 0.88 mm); Y-suture and fontanelle indistinct. Compound eyes broad, oval (maximum diameter 0.25 mm, minimum diameter 0.18 mm), separated from the lower margin of the head by less than their minimum diameter (0.13 mm). Ocelli small, broadly oval (long diameter 0.08 mm, short diameter 0.05 mm), separated from the compound eyes by about their long diameter (0.08 mm). Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 shortest; segment 2 almost equal to the sum of segments 3 and 4. Postclypeus slightly convex, pilose; more than half as long as wide (length 0.25 mm, width 0.45 mm), posterior part projecting toward the frons. Pronotum subsemicircular (length 0.48 mm, width 0.78 mm).
